Cleanup activities can be
individually triggered from the
OSRestartTask (note:
CallTrustedFunction shall be used to
switch to the BSW partition), or the
RestartTask can trigger the BSW
Mode Manager (BswM) which can
be configured with an action list
containing the cleanup activities
(the BswM must also be triggered
using CallTrustedFunction).
The cleanup activities are project
specific. This example contains
synchronous and asynchronous
activities.
